bug.summary: Illegal argument exception when extracting .tgz file
bug.description:
When attempting to unpack a .tgz file, I am receiving the illegal argument exception: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Invalid byte 0 at offset 5 in '05412

{NUL}11' len=8. This is causing a java.io.IOException: Error detected parsing the header error. 

This is being thrown when the function TarArchiveInputStream.getNextTarEntry() is called. 

Here is the code I am using. 

TarArchiveInputStream tarIn = 
new
TarArchiveInputStream(

new
GZIPInputStream(

new
BufferedInputStream(

new
FileInputStream(
tempDirPath + fileName))));

TarArchiveEntry entry = tarIn.getNextTarEntry();

while
(entry != 
null
) {
File path = 
new
File(tempDirPath, entry.getName());

if
(entry.isDirectory()) {
path.mkdirs();
} 
else
{ 
path.createNewFile();

byte
[] read = 
new

byte
[2048];
BufferedOutputStream bout = 
new
BufferedOutputStream(
new
FileOutputStream(path));

int
len;

while
((len = tarIn.read(read)) != -1) {
bout.write(read, 0, len);

System
.out.print(
new

String
(read, 
"UTF-8"
));
}
bout.close();
read = 
null
;
}
entry = tarIn.getNextTarEntry();
}
tarIn.close();
